subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/673bc505a27de4936b0451875c24f72c8250fba02c25a2c40b50878d6f93b4ef.png]
solution:
The figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series is as shown below :

 
• Semi-circle is rotated 45⁰ clockwise and interchange position with slant line from figure to figure.
 
• In figure 1 and figure 3 one slant line is present on left side.
 
• In figure 2 and figure 4 two slant lines are present on right side.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cfc30a9f98f18f5e1670d72b8447cca3b0af8639813e7ff098383eb86da06cf.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
